title: Potential increased bleeding risk
why: Concomitant use of ibuprofen and warfarin can increase the risk of serious bleeding compared with either medicine alone.
review: A qualified clinician or pharmacist should review this combination before use. Monitor for signs of bleeding as clinically appropriate.
source: US FDA/DailyMed Warfarin Sodium Prescribing Information, section 7.3, Drugs that Increase Bleeding Risk: https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/lookup.cfm?setid=51e98fb6-ba76-497e-95d8-fe895ef0b7ed ; NHS Warfarin medicine guidance: https://www.nhs.uk/medicines/warfarin/
